jared: fine with 12m demo — plan to show Redwood Dedicated + CloudArc marketplace flow and an EdgeWorks on-prem inference fallback. Need a second laptop and the NVMe staging box.

devin: scheduling note — we should do a 30m tech rehearsal 3 days before and a 60m full run 1 day before. I'll create invites.

sophie: CloudArc shipping contact: Alan - alan@cloudarc.io, phone +1-415-555-0199. Ship to:

```
CloudArc Inc - Events
Attn: Alan (platform)
425 Market St, 6th Fl
San Francisco, CA 94105
```

Please mark as "Event tech - Redwood demo". ETA 3 business days.

jared: thanks. I'll package laptop + USB-C hub + HDMI adapter. Will drop off Mon AM. Tracking will be in this thread.

devin: I can handle stickers and courier. Need size breakdown for tees by Thu. Suggest we bring 30 L, 40 M, 30 S, rest unisex XS-L mix.

ops-bot: Reminder: AV checklist required 72 hours before event. Attach runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/webinar-av

sophie: can we confirm recording permissions with CloudArc? Alan said yes but will sign form. Alan — ping to confirm speaker recording consent.

alan (CloudArc): Confirmed — CloudArc signed the recording consent form earlier today. Happy to share raw demo video for post-event edits.

maya: perfect. Action items: 1) Devin — run-of-show + invites (by Tue) 2) Jared — pack & ship laptop + dongles, post tracking (by Mon) 3) Sophie — tee sizes + swag vendor contact (by Thu) 4) Ops — AV checklist + backup streaming key (by 72h before). Anyone else?

devin: I'll put run-of-show in the shared deck: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1EXAMPLE — please add speaker slides there.

jared: tracking 1Z999AA10123456784 (UPS) - laptop dropped at 10:12am. ETA Wed.

sophie: tee vendor is ThreadCo (contact rosa@threadco.com). I'll request expedited printing and confirm sizes.

maya: small contingency for demo fallback: if EdgeWorks box can't present, we fall back to pre-recorded NVMe demo (2m). Jared — can you finalize that clip?

jared: yes, will produce a 2m trimmed clip and upload to the deck by Thu EOD.

maya: last note — marketing wants 1 banner image + 3 social cards. I'll loop in Kelsey after this thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
